column2: When the number of acknowledgements required and the number of logs that must be compared to elect a leader are chosen such that there is guaranteed to be an overlap, this is called a quorum.
Where the assignment strategy is controlled: on the consumer through partition.assignment.strategy; on the server through group.consumer.assignors (now cites both anchors).
Default assignor: RangeAssignor with CooperativeStickyAssignor as the upgrade; uniform (now cites both anchors).
In the DefaultErrorHandler example with FixedBackOff(1000L, 2L), failures are simply logged after retries are exhausted.
